hypotheses.statement: Indexed dynamic bytes arguments are keccak256-hashed into the EVM log topic (Solidity semantics), while solang/pallet-contracts emits the raw value (0xaabbccdd); this is a known semantic divergence, not a bug.

evidence.note: ThreeIndexed: EVM reports data=0x40eed0325a... (32-byte keccak hash of 0xaabbccdd), Polkadot reports raw 0xaabbccdd. Triage: known_semantic.

hypotheses.next_probe: Emit an event with an indexed string and an indexed bytes of length >32, and compare topic values on both chains to check whether long dynamic values are also emitted raw by solang.

hypotheses.statement: Address values in event args are rendered in native encoding — 20-byte hex on EVM, SS58/base58 on Polkadot — causing EVENT_MISMATCH even when the underlying identity is identical (deployer alice = 0x7099...79c8 = 5FHn...694ty).

evidence.note: TwoIndexed/ThreeIndexed address arg: 0x70997970c51812dc3a010c7d01b50e0d17dc79c8 vs 5FHneW46xGXgs5mUiveU4sbTyGBzmstUspZC92UhjJM694ty — same alice account in both encodings.

hypotheses.next_probe: Emit an event with only uint/bool value-type args from a call by a known sender; if no mismatch appears, the address encoding is the sole cause of identity-mismatch false positives.

hypotheses.statement: Emission order and multiplicity are preserved identically on both chains: five emits in one transaction (OneIndexed, TwoIndexed, ThreeIndexed, Dup, Dup) appear in the same order with both duplicate Dup events intact.

evidence.note: Despite arg-level mismatches, all 5 events matched 1:1 in name, order, and multiplicity on both chains; non-indexed args (uint b, string c, uint n, uint v) all matched exactly.

hypotheses.next_probe: Emit events interleaved with a revert (all-or-nothing) and events from an internal call/delegatecall-style pattern to check ordering and atomicity on reverted subcalls.

hypotheses.statement: Constructor-emitted events (CtorIndexed) do not surface in the compared event stream on either chain — both sides omitted the constructor event from step-0 results without causing a mismatch, suggesting the oracle ignores deployment events.

evidence.note: CtorIndexed was defined and emitted in the constructor but appears in neither evm nor polkadot event lists at step 0, symmetrically.

hypotheses.next_probe: Deploy with an emitted constructor event, then check whether the harness records deployment-phase events at all (query logs from deployment block separately on both chains).
